title: Nvidia Fallout, Anthropic Listing Squeeze Asian Chip Stocks Anew
summary: Asia's two chip-heavy stock markets came under renewed pressure on Monday, tracking US weakness. Investors are dealing with Nvidia's turmoil and making room for Anthropic's much-anticipated share sale.

title: The perfect sell-off
summary: The FT's market briefing covers the latest tech sell-off. It also looks at the fast-tracking of Anthropic's IPO.

title: Skipping the Gym? British Bank Analysts Are Paying Attention
summary: UK bank equity analysts are watching missed gym payments as a possible early sign of consumer stress. Bloomberg reports the indicator is drawing attention as a read on credit quality.

title: Emerging-Market Stocks, Currencies Fall as AI Concerns Persist
summary: Emerging-market stocks fell to their lowest in a week as caution ahead of Nvidia's earnings weighed on technology shares. EM currencies also declined.

title: EQT Sees “Wave” of Take-Private Opportunities in Japan
summary: EQT chair Jean Eric Salata says the private equity firm plans to invest up to 30% of its $30 billion in dry powder in Japan. EQT sees a 'wave' of take-private opportunities there.

title: Biggest IPOs this year lose investors money as AI frenzy fades
summary: The ten biggest IPOs of 2026 have fallen more than 20% on average this year, after four years of gains for new listings. The FT ties the losses to a fading AI frenzy.

title: How Dual-Class Stock Entrenches Founder Control at Anthropic, SpaceX, Google
summary: The AI boom is eroding the 'one share, one vote' principle that checks founder power. Bloomberg looks at how dual-class stock structures entrench founder control at Anthropic, SpaceX and Google.

title: Alibaba Unveils New Flagship AI Model in Riposte to US Rivals
summary: Alibaba launched a new flagship AI model and claims performance that rivals Anthropic and OpenAI. It is China's latest challenge to the US leaders in frontier AI.

title: Morgan Stanley ‘Max Overweight’ Global Stocks on AI Cycle
summary: Morgan Stanley strategists recommend a 'max overweight' position in global stocks. They cite an intact AI capex cycle that should extend resilient economic and earnings growth into next year.

title: Buen Fin 2026: descuentos dominan las preferencias de los consumidores; tecnología lidera las ventas
summary: La Concanaco Servytur informó que los descuentos son el principal gancho del Buen Fin 2026, con la tecnología y electrónica liderando las ventas. El comercio mayorista y las cadenas comerciales dominan las preferencias de los consumidores.

title: Kakao Prepares for Historic Split of Internet Empire in AI Chase
summary: Kakao, which spent over a decade consolidating South Koreans' digital lives under one umbrella, will split up early next year. The move is a response to the changes brought about by AI.

title: Nvidia’s CEO Search Draws Fire With Bessent’s Shakeup Call
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is urging Nvidia to make a 'dramatic' leadership shakeup and come clean about its compliance with AI chip export controls. The pressure comes days after the board ousted CEO Jensen Huang.

title: Taisei Launches $150 Million AI, Robotics Fund With Pegasus Tech Ventures
summary: Japanese construction firm Taisei is funding a $150 million AI and robotics fund with Pegasus Tech Ventures. The 153-year-old company wants technology workarounds for a shrinking workforce.

title: Stocks Slide as Tech Selloff Worsens, Oil Rebounds: Markets Wrap
summary: Technology stocks plunged ahead of this week's Nvidia earnings and Anthropic's expected listing. Both events are seen as likely to shape the near-term course of an increasingly fragile AI trade, while oil rebounded.

title: Anthropic’s giant IPO puts the heat on OpenAI
summary: Anthropic's giant IPO is raising the competitive pressure on OpenAI. The Economist notes that coding agents have become big business, and asks what comes next for the frontier labs.

title: Jensen Huang discusses comeback as Nvidia CEO with allies
summary: Ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is discussing a comeback with allies, and tech supporters are lobbying the board to reinstate him. He resigned after an affair with an alleged Chinese spy came to light.

title: US and allies sign accord to protect AI supply chains from China
summary: The US and its allies signed an accord to protect AI technologies and supply chains from China. The pact comes ahead of Donald Trump's meeting with Xi Jinping at the APEC forum in Shenzhen.

title: Cuánto cuesta el Huawei Watch D3, el reloj que monitorea la presión arterial con grado médico
summary: El Huawei Watch D3 busca ser un asistente de salud de grado médico en la muñeca. Incorpora una bolsa de aire en la correa, similar a un baumanómetro, para medir la presión arterial.

title: Sam’s Club, Walmart, First Cash y Elektra encabezan las quejas en el primer día del Buen Fin
summary: Sam's Club, Walmart, First Cash y Elektra encabezan las quejas de consumidores en el primer día del Buen Fin 2026. La nota destaca a minoristas y empresas de crédito prendario entre los más reportados.

title: Buen Fin: qué hacer si te clonan la tarjeta después de realizar una compra
summary: Guía de Expansión sobre qué hacer si te clonan la tarjeta después de una compra durante el Buen Fin. Aborda los pasos ante fraudes con tarjetas bancarias en la temporada de mayores compras.

title: Microsoft restablece por completo sus servicios pero advierte a usuarios por aumento de 'phishing'
summary: Microsoft restableció por completo sus servicios tras una falla, pero advirtió a los usuarios sobre un aumento en intentos de 'phishing'.

title: Vanguard House / Ming Architects
summary: Vanguard House by Ming Architects is a spacious residence built around privacy and serenity. Concealed living spaces and central water features create a light, relaxing atmosphere.

title: Minthis Resort Development / Woods Bagot
summary: Woods Bagot's London studio delivered master planning, architecture, interiors and branding for Minthis, a hillside resort-style development in Paphos, Cyprus, with developer Pafilia. It blends local antiquity with premium amenities.

title: ¿Por qué el petróleo no ha provocado una crisis económica mayor? Goldman analiza el efecto en América Latina
summary: Goldman Sachs analiza por qué el fuerte encarecimiento del petróleo tras la guerra con Irán no ha provocado la crisis económica que se temía en América Latina. Atribuye la resistencia de las economías emergentes a factores estructurales, medidas gubernamentales y una inflación menor de la prevista.
